name: lake
desc: A gentle young man in his late twenties: the village lamplighter. Tousled wavy brown hair, soft warm brown eyes, a warm boyish friendly face, a calm kind manner. He wears a long charcoal dark-grey HOODED cape draped softly over both shoulders like a shawl (hood down, resting at the back of the neck) and falling to his ankles, closing at the throat with a small brass flame-shaped clasp, over a white band-collar shirt with full sleeves and a dark green laced vest with cord X-lacing down the front, brown pants, and brown boots. No chest strap.
